RemoveApps.Label: Remove the apps specified with the 'Apps' parameter

Apps.Label: The selection of apps to remove, specified as a comma separated list. Use 'Default' (or omit) to use the default apps list

RemoveGamingApps.Label: Remove the Xbox App and Xbox Gamebar

DisableTelemetry.Label: Disable telemetry, tracking & targeted ads
DisableTelemetry.ToolTip: This setting disables telemetry, diagnostic data collection, activity history, app-launch tracking, targeted ads and more. It limits the data that is sent to Microsoft about your device and usage. If you are a Windows Insider, updates may be blocked until optional diagnostic data collection is turned back on.
DisableTelemetry.ApplyText: Disabling telemetry and diagnostic data collection
DisableTelemetry.ApplyUndoText: Enabling telemetry and diagnostic data collection

DisableSuggestions.Label: Disable tips, tricks & suggested content throughout Windows
DisableSuggestions.ToolTip: This setting removes many annoying distractions from Windows. This includes things like notifications, reminders and sync provider ads. It also prevents automated installation of suggested apps.
DisableSuggestions.ApplyText: Disabling tips, tricks, suggestions and ads throughout Windows
DisableSuggestions.UndoLabel: Enable tips, tricks & suggested content throughout Windows
DisableSuggestions.ApplyUndoText: Enabling tips, tricks, suggestions and ads throughout Windows

DisableNotifications.Label: Disable Windows Notifications (From apps and other senders)
DisableNotifications.ToolTip: Disables native Windows notifications from apps and other senders, this includes notifications from apps like Discord, WhatsApp, Teams, and Slack.

DisableLocationServices.Label: Disable Windows location services & app location access
DisableLocationServices.ToolTip: This will turn off Windows Location Services and deny apps access to your location. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
DisableLocationServices.ApplyText: Disabling Windows location services and app location access
DisableLocationServices.UndoLabel: Enable Windows location services & app location access
DisableLocationServices.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Windows location services and app location access

DisableFindMyDevice.Label: Disable Find My Device location tracking
DisableFindMyDevice.ToolTip: This will turn off the 'Find My Device' feature, which periodically sends your device's location to Microsoft. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
DisableFindMyDevice.ApplyText: Disabling Find My Device location tracking
DisableFindMyDevice.UndoLabel: Enable Find My Device location tracking
DisableFindMyDevice.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Find My Device location tracking

DisableLockscreenTips.Label: Disable tips & tricks on the lock screen
DisableLockscreenTips.ToolTip: This will turn off the lockscreen spotlight option and disable the tips, tricks and fun facts that appear on the lock screen.
DisableLockscreenTips.ApplyText: Disabling tips & tricks on the lock screen
DisableLockscreenTips.UndoLabel: Enable tips & tricks on the lock screen
DisableLockscreenTips.ApplyUndoText: Enabling tips & tricks on the lock screen

EnableDesktopSpotlight.Label: Enable Windows spotlight desktop background and shortcut
EnableDesktopSpotlight.ToolTip: Restores the Windows spotlight desktop background and the 'Learn about this picture' shortcut.
EnableDesktopSpotlight.ApplyText: Restoring the Windows spotlight desktop background and shortcut

DisableDesktopSpotlight.Label: Disable Windows spotlight desktop background
DisableDesktopSpotlight.ToolTip: Turns off Windows spotlight for the desktop background, which displays rotating images and may show tips and fun facts. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
DisableDesktopSpotlight.ApplyText: Disabling the Windows spotlight desktop background
DisableDesktopSpotlight.ApplyUndoText: Restoring the Windows spotlight desktop background and shortcut

HideDesktopSpotlightIcon.Label: Hide the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut
HideDesktopSpotlightIcon.ToolTip: Hides the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut while keeping Windows spotlight wallpaper rotation enabled. It does not disable Windows spotlight.

HideDesktopSpotlightIcon.UndoLabel: Show the 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut
HideDesktopSpotlightIcon.ApplyUndoText: Showing the Windows spotlight 'Learn about this picture' desktop shortcut

DisableEdgeAds.Label: Disable ads, suggestions and newsfeed in Edge
DisableEdgeAds.ToolTip: This will turn off various distractions from Microsoft Edge such as ads, suggestions and the MSN news feed. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableEdgeAds.UndoLabel: Enable ads, suggestions and newsfeed in Edge
DisableEdgeAds.ApplyUndoText: Enabling ads, suggestions and the MSN news feed in Microsoft Edge

DisableCopilot.Label: Disable Microsoft Copilot
DisableCopilot.ToolTip: This will disable and uninstall Microsoft Copilot, Windows' built-in AI assistant.

DisableRecall.Label: Disable Windows Recall
DisableRecall.ToolTip: This will disable Windows Recall, an AI-powered feature that provides quick access to recently used files, apps and activities. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableClickToDo.Label: Disable Click To Do, AI text & image analysis
DisableClickToDo.ToolTip: This will disable Click To Do, which provides AI-powered text and image analysis features in Windows. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
DisableClickToDo.UndoLabel: Enable Click To Do, AI text & image analysis

DisableAISvcAutoStart.Label: Prevent AI service from starting automatically
DisableAISvcAutoStart.ToolTip: This will set the WSAIFabricSvc service to manual startup, preventing the service from starting automatically with Windows.

DisableAISvcAutoStart.UndoLabel: Allow AI service to start automatically
DisableAISvcAutoStart.ApplyUndoText: Allowing AI service to start automatically

DisableDVR.Label: Disable Xbox game/screen recording
DisableDVR.ToolTip: This will disable the Xbox game/screen recording features included with the Game Bar app. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableGameBarIntegration.Label: Disable Game Bar integration
DisableGameBarIntegration.ToolTip: This will disable the Game Bar integration with games and controllers. This stops annoying ms-gamebar popups when launching games or connecting a controller.

DisableStartRecommended.ApplyUndoText: Enabling the start menu recommended section

DisableStartAllApps.ToolTip: This will hide the 'All Apps' section in the start menu, which shows all installed apps. WARNING: Hiding this section may make it harder to find installed apps on your system. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableStartAllApps.ApplyUndoText: Enabling the 'All Apps' section in the start menu

DisableStartPhoneLink.Label: Disable Phone Link integration in the start menu
DisableStartPhoneLink.ToolTip: This will remove the Phone Link integration in the start menu when you have a mobile device linked to your PC.

DisableStartPhoneLink.UndoLabel: Enable Phone Link integration in the start menu
DisableStartPhoneLink.ApplyUndoText: Enabling the Phone Link mobile devices integration in the start menu

DisableBing.Label: Disable Bing web search & Copilot integration in search
DisableBing.ToolTip: This will turn off Bing web search results and Copilot integration in the Windows search experience. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableBing.UndoLabel: Enable Bing web search & Copilot integration in search
DisableBing.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Bing web search & Copilot integration in Windows search

DisableStoreSearchSuggestions.Label: Disable Microsoft Store app suggestions in search
DisableStoreSearchSuggestions.ToolTip: This will disable the Microsoft Store app suggestions in Windows search.

DisableStoreSearchSuggestions.UndoLabel: Enable Microsoft Store app suggestions in search
DisableStoreSearchSuggestions.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Microsoft Store app suggestions in search

DisableSettings365Ads.Label: Hide Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home
DisableSettings365Ads.ToolTip: This will turn off the Microsoft 365 Copilot ads that appear in the Settings Home page.

DisableSettings365Ads.UndoLabel: Show Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home
DisableSettings365Ads.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home

DisableEdgeAI.Label: Disable AI features in Microsoft Edge
DisableEdgeAI.ToolTip: This will turn off AI features in Microsoft Edge, such as the AI-powered sidebar and Copilot features. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableEdgeAI.UndoLabel: Enable AI features in Microsoft Edge
DisableEdgeAI.ApplyUndoText: Enabling AI features in Microsoft Edge

DisablePaintAI.ToolTip: This will turn off AI features in Paint, such as the AI-powered image generation and editing tools. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableNotepadAI.Label: Disable AI features in Notepad
DisableNotepadAI.ToolTip: This will turn off AI features in Notepad, such as the AI-powered writing suggestions. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

EnableDarkMode.Label: Enable dark theme for system and apps
EnableDarkMode.ToolTip: This will set the app and system theme to dark mode.

EnableDarkMode.ApplyUndoText: Disabling dark mode for system and apps

DisableDragTray.Label: Disable 'Drag Tray' for sharing & moving files

RevertContextMenu.Label: Use classic Windows 10 context menu style

RevertContextMenu.ApplyUndoText: Restoring the Windows 11 style context menu

DisableMouseAcceleration.Label: Disable Enhance Pointer Precision (mouse acceleration)
DisableMouseAcceleration.ToolTip: This will disable mouse acceleration which is enabled by default in Windows. This makes mouse movement more consistent and predictable.

DisableStickyKeys.Label: Disable Sticky Keys keyboard shortcut (5x shift)
DisableStickyKeys.ToolTip: This will prevent the Sticky Keys dialog from appearing when you press the Shift key 5 times in a row.

DisableWindowSnapping.ToolTip: This will turn off the ability to snap windows to the sides or corners of the screen.

DisableSnapAssist.UndoLabel: Enable showing app suggestions when snapping windows

DisableSnapLayouts.Label: Hide snap layout flyout at top of screen and on maximize button
DisableSnapLayouts.ToolTip: This will turn off the snap layout flyout that appears when you hover over the maximize button or drag windows to the top of the screen.

HideTaskview.ToolTip: This will disable the 'Task view' button on the taskbar, which allows you to see all your open windows and virtual desktops.

HideTaskview.ApplyUndoText: Showing the taskview button from the taskbar

DisableWidgets.Label: Disable widgets on the taskbar & lock screen
DisableWidgets.ToolTip: This will disable the widgets features in Windows, including the widgets button on the taskbar and the widgets that can appear on the lock screen.
DisableWidgets.ApplyText: Disabling widgets on the taskbar & lock screen

HideChat.ApplyUndoText: Showing the chat icon from the taskbar

DisableStorageSense.Label: Disable Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup
DisableStorageSense.ToolTip: This will disable Storage Sense, which automatically frees up disk space by deleting temporary files, emptying the recycle bin and cleaning up files in the Downloads folder.
DisableStorageSense.ApplyText: Disabling Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup
DisableStorageSense.UndoLabel: Enable Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup
DisableStorageSense.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Storage Sense automatic disk cleanup

DisableFastStartup.Label: Disable fast start-up
DisableFastStartup.ToolTip: Fast Start-up helps your PC start faster after shutdown by saving a system image to disk. Disabling Fast Start-up can help with certain issues, but may result in slightly longer boot times.

DisableBitlockerAutoEncryption.Label: Disable BitLocker automatic device encryption
DisableBitlockerAutoEncryption.ToolTip: For devices that support it, Windows 11 automatically enables BitLocker device encryption. Disabling this will turn off automatic encryption of the device, but you can still manually enable BitLocker encryption if desired. Drives that are already encrypted with BitLocker will remain encrypted when this setting is applied.

DisableModernStandbyNetworking.Label: Disable Modern Standby network connectivity
DisableModernStandbyNetworking.ToolTip: By default, devices that support Modern Standby maintain network connectivity while in sleep mode. Disabling network connectivity during Modern Standby can help save battery life.
DisableModernStandbyNetworking.ApplyText: Disabling network connectivity during Modern Standby
DisableModernStandbyNetworking.ApplyUndoText: Enabling network connectivity during Modern Standby

EnableEndTask.Label: Show 'End Task' option in taskbar context menu
EnableEndTask.ToolTip: When enabled, adds an 'End Task' option to the right-click context menu for apps in the taskbar, allowing you to quickly force close apps.
EnableEndTask.ApplyText: Enabling the 'End Task' option in the taskbar right click menu
EnableEndTask.UndoLabel: Hide 'End Task' option in taskbar context menu
EnableEndTask.ApplyUndoText: Disabling the 'End Task' option in the taskbar right click menu

EnableLastActiveClick.Label: Enable 'Last Active Click' behavior for taskbar apps
EnableLastActiveClick.ToolTip: When enabled, clicking on an app in the taskbar will switch to the last active window of that app, instead of only showing the thumbnail preview.

EnableLastActiveClick.UndoLabel: Disable 'Last Active Click' behavior for taskbar apps
EnableLastActiveClick.ApplyUndoText: Disabling the 'Last Active Click' behavior in the taskbar app area

ShowKnownFileExt.ToolTip: This will show file extensions for known file types. By default, Windows hides file extensions for known file types which can lead to confusion and security risks.

ShowKnownFileExt.UndoLabel: Hide file extensions for known file types
ShowKnownFileExt.ApplyUndoText: Disabling file extensions for known file types

ShowHiddenFolders.Label: Show hidden files, folders and drives
ShowHiddenFolders.ToolTip: By default, Windows hides certain files, folders and drives to prevent accidental modification or deletion. Turn this on to show all files in File Explorer.

ShowHiddenFolders.UndoLabel: Hide hidden files, folders and drives
ShowHiddenFolders.ApplyUndoText: Hiding hidden files, folders and drives

HideDupliDrive.ToolTip: By default, Windows shows removable drives both under 'This PC' and in the navigation pane with its own entry. Enable this setting to only show removable drives under 'This PC'.
HideDupliDrive.ApplyText: Hiding duplicate removable drive entries from the File Explorer navigation pane
HideDupliDrive.ApplyUndoText: Showing duplicate removable drive entries from the File Explorer navigation pane

DisableTransparency.Label: Disable transparency effects
DisableTransparency.ToolTip: This will disable transparency effects on Windows and interfaces. Which can help improve performance on older hardware.

DisableAnimations.Label: Disable animations and visual effects
DisableAnimations.ToolTip: This will disable animations and some visual effects in Windows, which can make the interface feel snappier, especially on older hardware.

DisableUpdateASAP.Label: Prevent getting updates as soon as they're available
DisableUpdateASAP.ToolTip: This will prevent your PC from being among the first to receive new non-security updates. Your PC will still receive these updates eventually.
DisableUpdateASAP.ApplyText: Preventing Windows from getting updates as soon as they are available
DisableUpdateASAP.UndoLabel: Allow getting updates as soon as they're available
DisableUpdateASAP.ApplyUndoText: Allowing Windows to get updates as soon as they are available

PreventUpdateAutoReboot.Label: Prevent automatic restarts after updates while signed in
PreventUpdateAutoReboot.ToolTip: This will prevent your PC from automatically restarting after updates while any user is signed in.

PreventUpdateAutoReboot.ApplyUndoText: Allowing automatic restarts after updates while signed in

DisableDeliveryOptimization.Label: Disable sharing downloaded updates with other PCs
DisableDeliveryOptimization.ToolTip: This will prevent your PC from sharing downloaded updates with other PCs on the local network or on the internet. This also prevents your PC from downloading updates from other PCs.

DisableDeliveryOptimization.UndoLabel: Enable sharing downloaded updates with other PCs

AddFoldersToThisPC.Label: Add common folders back to 'This PC' page
AddFoldersToThisPC.ToolTip: This setting will add common folders like Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures and Videos back to the 'This PC' page in File Explorer.
AddFoldersToThisPC.ApplyText: Adding all common folders (Desktop, Downloads, etc.) back to 'This PC' in File Explorer
AddFoldersToThisPC.UndoLabel: Remove common folders back to 'This PC' page
AddFoldersToThisPC.ApplyUndoText: Removing all common folders (Desktop, Downloads, etc.) back to 'This PC' in File Explorer

HideIncludeInLibrary.ToolTip: Hides the 'Include in library' option from the File Explorer context menu.

HideIncludeInLibrary.UndoLabel: Show 'Include in library' option in the context menu
HideIncludeInLibrary.ApplyUndoText: Showing 'Include in library' in the context menu

HideGiveAccessTo.ToolTip: Hides the 'Give access to' option from the File Explorer context menu.

DisableBraveBloat.Label: Disable bloat in Brave browser (AI, Crypto, etc.)
DisableBraveBloat.ToolTip: This will disable Brave's built-in AI features, Crypto wallet, News, Rewards, Talk and VPN. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.

DisableBraveBloat.UndoLabel: Enable Brave browser features (AI, Crypto, etc.)
DisableBraveBloat.ApplyUndoText: Enabling Brave AI, Crypto, News, Rewards, Talk and VPN in Brave browser

EnableWindowsSandbox.Label: Enable Windows Sandbox
EnableWindowsSandbox.ToolTip: Windows Sandbox is a lightweight desktop environment for safely running applications in isolation. Software installed inside the Windows Sandbox environment remains 'sandboxed' and runs separately from the host machine. Only supported on Windows 11 Pro, Workstation, and Enterprise editions.

EnableWindowsSubsystemForLinux.Label: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux
EnableWindowsSubsystemForLinux.ToolTip: Windows Subsystem for Linux allows you to run a Linux environment directly on Windows without the need for a virtual machine.

ShowDriveLettersFirst.Label: Show drive letters before drive label
ShowDriveLettersFirst.ToolTip: This setting will show drive letters before the drive label in File Explorer.

ShowNetworkDriveLettersFirst.Label: Show network drive letters before drive label

StartAllAppsCategory.Label: Show All Apps in Category view (Default)
StartAllAppsCategory.ToolTip: This will set the All Apps section in the start menu to show apps grouped by category.
StartAllAppsCategory.ApplyText: Setting All Apps view to Category

StartAllAppsGrid.Label: Show All Apps in Grid view
StartAllAppsGrid.ToolTip: This will set the All Apps section in the start menu to show apps in an alphabetical grid layout.

StartAllAppsGrid.ApplyUndoText: Setting All Apps view to Category

StartAllAppsList.ApplyUndoText: Setting All Apps view to Category

DesktopSpotlight.Label: Windows spotlight on the desktop
DesktopSpotlight.ToolTip: This setting controls the Windows spotlight desktop background option. Keep the rotating wallpaper with or without the 'Learn about this picture' shortcut, or disable Windows spotlight entirely.

SearchIcon.Label: Taskbar search style
SearchIcon.ToolTip: This setting allows you to customize the appearance of the search box on the taskbar.

MultiMon.Label: Show taskbar apps on
MultiMon.ToolTip: This setting allows you to choose where taskbar app buttons are shown when using multiple monitors.

Values.MMTaskbarModeMainActive: Main taskbar and taskbar where window is open

CombineButtons.Label: Combine taskbar buttons on the main display
CombineButtons.ToolTip: This setting allows you to choose how taskbar buttons are combined on the main display.

CombineMMButtons.Label: Combine taskbar buttons on secondary displays
CombineMMButtons.ToolTip: This setting allows you to choose how taskbar buttons are combined on secondary displays.

ClearStart.Label: Remove pinned apps from the start menu
ClearStart.ToolTip: This setting allows you to quickly remove all pinned apps from the start menu.

ExplorerLocation.Label: Open File Explorer to
ExplorerLocation.ToolTip: This setting allows you to choose the default location that File Explorer opens to.

DriveLetterPosition.Label: Drive letter position
DriveLetterPosition.ToolTip: This setting allows you to choose where drive letters are shown in File Explorer.

Values.ShowDriveLettersLast: Show drive letters after drive label (Default)
Values.ShowDriveLettersFirst: Show drive letters before drive label
Values.ShowNetworkDriveLettersFirst: Show network drive letters before drive label

ShowTabsInAltTab.Label: Show tabs from apps when snapping or pressing Alt+Tab
ShowTabsInAltTab.ToolTip: This setting allows you to choose whether to show tabs from apps (such as Edge browser tabs) when snapping windows or pressing Alt+Tab.

StartAllAppsView.Label: Start menu 'All Apps' view
StartAllAppsView.ToolTip: This setting allows you to change the layout of the 'All Apps' section in the start menu, or hide it entirely. Hiding this section may make it harder to find installed apps on your system. This feature uses policies, which will lock down certain settings.
